usageNote: 口语常用！想表达"烧钱"的感觉，这短语超自然。比 'spend much money' 地道多了！

examples.en: I had to pay a lot of money to fix my car after the accident.
examples.zh: 事故后我不得不花了很多钱修车。

examples.en: She paid a lot of money for that designer handbag.
examples.zh: 她花了很多钱买那个名牌包。
